title: Be Friendly, Not Friends: How LLM Sycophancy Shapes User Trust
reasoning: The paper focuses on an empirical human-computer interaction (HCI) study regarding user trust and the perception of sycophancy in LLMs. While it includes sections on 'Ethical and Design Implications' and 'Designing for Ethical LLM Agents,' these serve as discussion points for the experimental findings rather than as a core component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical systems.
